faces.name: Legend Race vs. Special Week
faces.text:
At the start of the game, the player who goes second has 3 Evolution Points.
You can use an Evolution Point toward paying an {icon_evolve|[evolve]} or {icon_carrot|[feed]} cost by flipping this card over so that the card back is showing. An Evolution Point is equal to 1 play point. (You can perform either {icon_evolve|[evolve]} or {icon_carrot|[feed]} once per turn. Only 1 Evolution Point can be used at a time.)
